children: NPK International Chief Financial Officer Gregg Piontek will retire by the end of August of next year.

The company said Wednesday that it appointed Matthew Warren as chief accounting officer earlier this week in connection with Piontek's retirement plans. Warren is succeeding Piontek as the company's principal accounting officer.
NPK also engaged an executive search firm to launch a search for Piontek's successor.
Piontek will be retained after his retirement to support the transition.
